title: Register for an NTN
description: National Tax Number for an individual on IRIS.

questions.prompt_ru: Kya IRIS login pehle se hai?

steps.title: Read the registration provision

steps.detail: Use the FBR IRIS portal. This build only links the confirmed IRIS address.
